description: This file defines the IAsyncBatchObservable interface in the Orleans.Streams namespace, providing methods for subscribing to batch streams with or without a starting sequence token.

classes.name: IAsyncBatchObservable
classes.description: An interface for asynchronously subscribing to batch streams, allowing consumers to receive batches of items with or without a starting sequence token.

methods.name: SubscribeAsync (observer)
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to the batch observable stream, returning a task that resolves to a subscription handle.

methods.name: SubscribeAsync (observer, token)
methods.description: Subscribes an observer to the batch observable stream starting from a specified sequence token, returning a task that resolves to a subscription handle.
